title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-28

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard recording that’s a bit bass‑light and windy, but the show is a gem with standout versions of China Cat Sunflower, Rider and Eyes.
ai_review.review: The two reviewers rave about the performance, calling it a “gem of a show” and highlighting scorching renditions of China Cat Sunflower, Rider and Eyes. The soundboard source is clear and crisp, though listeners note a thin low‑end, noticeable wind noise and an over‑present whine on the “He’s Gone > Truckin’” segue.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers give 5 stars, praising the musical performance while noting only moderate recording quirks; strong show weight (70%) and decent technical quality (30%) push the rating into the high‑range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp overall but a bit bassless, needs EQ; noticeable wind noise; whine/distortion on the "He's Gone > Truckin'" transition.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth flow with strong transitions; the second set (including the highlighted jams) is especially praised.
